def VTask.bitCasesOn {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (n : ℕ) (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive (Nat.bit b n)) : motive n := by
  have h : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      match n with
      | 0 =>
        -- Base case: n = 0
        have h₁ : motive 0 := by
          have h₂ := bit false 0
          simpa using h₂
        exact h₁
      | n + 1 =>
        -- Recursive case: n + 1 > 0
        have h₁ := bit (Nat.testBit (n + 1) 0) ((n + 1) / 2)
        have h₂ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit (Nat.testBit (n + 1) 0) ((n + 1) / 2) := by
          -- Prove that n + 1 = Nat.bit (n + 1).testBit 0 ((n + 1) / 2)
          have h₃ : (n + 1) / 2 < n + 1 := by
            apply Nat.div_lt_self
            · norm_num
            · norm_num
          have h₄ : Nat.bit (Nat.testBit (n + 1) 0) ((n + 1) / 2) = (n + 1) := by
            rw [Nat.bit_eq_iff]
            <;> simp_all [Nat.testBit_zero, Nat.div_eq_of_lt, Nat.div_lt_self]
            <;> norm_num
            <;> omega
          omega
        simpa [h₂] using h₁
  exact h n
